caption: The video captures a night harbor scene where fireworks bursts illuminate the black sky above the shoreline. A low lit building and a bridge sit on the left, moored sailboats line the right, and streetlights dot the waterfront, mirrored in the calm dark water. A small white spherical burst, already glowing left-of-center, enlarges and turns green, growing into a broad cloud-like spread near the middle of the frame. Two small orange star-shaped bursts appear to its right and persist, while additional bursts overlap and expand in place. Vertical white light streaks stand near the right side of the sky, while the central green burst dims into sparse purple and pink dots as another green burst on the right stays bright. The water tracks each event with shimmering reflections.
